The recording begins by launching the submitted Mac build from Finder or the Dock. It shows saving/reopening a diary entry, importing/previewing a timer sound, timer start/pause/resume and completion, switching features while timing continues, generating/copying a password, and opening the privacy policy.

No account or sign-in is required, and there is no account creation, subscription, or in-app purchase flow. Diary entries and timer sounds are private local content; the app has no posting, sharing, messaging, or user-interaction platform. The core features work offline without an external backend. Features are consistent across distribution regions; the UI is Japanese with English feature names.

The privacy policy is available from プライバシーポリシー (Privacy Policy) at the bottom of the sidebar on every feature screen. It opens https://prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp/privacy in the default browser.

To test completion audio, save review-tone.wav to the Mac, open Timer > 終了音 (Completion sound) > 音声を追加 (Add audio), and select it in the macOS file chooser. Preview the sound, run a one-minute timer with Prelis running and the Mac awake, then use リセット (Reset) to stop the completion sound.

Thank you for reviewing our submission.
